query: What is Multimodal (vision and language) models?
normalized_query: what is multimodal (vision and language) models
answer: Multimodal (vision and language) models, often called vision-language models (VLMs), are AI systems that take both images and text as input and learn to map them into a shared representation space so the two modalities can be reasoned about jointly. Architecturally they typically pair a visual encoder (e.g., a CNN or Vision Transformer) with a language model, connected either through dual encoders trained to align image-text pairs or through a fusion/projection layer that feeds visual features into a text generator. This enables tasks such as image captioning, visual question answering, text-to-image retrieval, and document understanding, often with strong zero-shot generalization to new image types.
